turns.text: And I'd give up forever to touch you
turns.zh: 我愿意放弃永恒，只为触碰你

turns.text: 'Cause I know that you feel me somehow
turns.zh: 因为我知道你总能感受到我

turns.text: You're the closest to heaven that I'll ever be
turns.zh: 你是我此生最接近天堂的存在

turns.text: And I don't want to go home right now
turns.zh: 而我现在不想回家

turns.text: And all I can taste is this moment
turns.zh: 此刻我只尝得到这一瞬间的味道

turns.text: And all I can breathe is your life
turns.zh: 我呼吸的只有你的生命气息

turns.text: And sooner or later, it's over
turns.zh: 迟早，一切都会结束

turns.text: I just don't wanna miss you tonight
turns.zh: 我只是不想今晚错过你

turns.text: And I don't want the world to see me
turns.zh: 我不想让这世界看见我

turns.text: 'Cause I don't think that they'd understand
turns.zh: 因为我觉得他们不会懂

turns.text: When everything's made to be broken
turns.zh: 当一切都注定破碎

turns.text: I just want you to know who I am
turns.zh: 我只想让你知道我是谁

turns.text: And you can't fight the tears that ain't coming
turns.zh: 你无法强求那些流不出的眼泪

turns.text: Or the moment of truth in your lies
turns.zh: 也无法逃避谎言中真相浮现的那一刻

turns.text: When everything feels like the movies
turns.zh: 当一切感觉像电影一样

turns.text: Yeah, you bleed just to know, you're alive
turns.zh: 是啊，你流血只是为了知道自己还活着
